def add_minutes_with_day_offset(time_str, minutes):
    hours_str, mins_str = time_str.split(':')
    total = int(hours_str) * 60 + int(mins_str) + minutes
    day_offset = total // 1440
    remainder = total % 1440
    new_hours = remainder // 60
    new_mins = remainder % 60
    return (day_offset, f'{new_hours:02d}:{new_mins:02d}')
